answer_1.quote: Our harmful data comes from the Harmful SafeRLHF dataset, derived from PKU-SafeRLHF. The dataset contains dangerous user requests paired with detailed, compliant model responses.
answer_1.outputs: Responses to harmful user queries (e.g., bomb-making instructions)

answer_2.quote: We evaluate responses using StrongREJECT, which assesses 60 prompts across six harm categories. The benchmark uses GPT-4o-mini to score responses on refusal (binary) and effectiveness (specificity and convincingness on 5-point Likert scales).
